editorial:
Imagine a world where your dream wedding becomes a total nightmare because of a piece of jewelry. You get a wild ride with two detectives who are trying to stop a killer obsessed with his mother's old wedding ring. Every time a new bride gets the ring, the killer shows up to take it back in the most violent way possible. The vibe is a strange mix of a scary slasher and a dark comedy. It does not take itself too seriously, which makes the whole experience feel like a fun B-movie night with your friends. 

What really works here is the fast pace and the goofy chemistry between the leads. While some of the special effects look a bit dated, the twists keep you guessing until the very end. If you love movies that are equal parts creepy and silly, you should definitely give this one a shot. Since it is an older flick, you might want to look for a digital rental on Apple TV to see it in the best quality possible. Or, if you love collecting physical media, adding the Blu-ray to your shelf is a great way to keep this weird gem forever.
endingExplained: The final act reveals that the killer is actually driven by a twisted love for his mother. After a chaotic chase, the detectives finally catch up to him during another wedding. In a messy showdown, the killer is stopped once and for all, and the cursed ring is finally taken out of circulation. It ends on a light note, showing that the cycle of death is over and the detectives can finally relax.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedies and old-school slasher movies.
